<article id="post-11895" class="post-11895 page type-page status-publish" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" itemscope>
	<div class="inside-article">
		
		<div class="entry-content" itemprop="text">
					<div data-elementor-type="wp-page" data-elementor-id="11895" class="elementor elementor-11895 elementor-10210" data-elementor-post-type="page">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-4f1e570 e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-parent" data-id="4f1e570" data-element_type="container">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-a82c78e e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="a82c78e" data-element_type="container">
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-8718986 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="8718986" data-element_type="container" data-settings='{"background_background":"classic"}'>
				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-c6b529d e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="c6b529d" data-element_type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-840cc87 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="840cc87" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<div class="column step-3-12"><div id="site-container-54025" class="Container ModuleElement Textarea AutoResizable con-225 " data-snap="1" data-containertype="Textarea" data-moduleelement="24501"><div class="Module-24501 Textarea"><h1 class="">Camping cabins in scenic surroundings by the North Sea</h1></div></div></div>
<div class="column step-3-12"><div id="site-container-95541" class="Container ModuleElement Textarea AutoResizable con-64 " data-snap="1" data-containertype="Textarea" data-moduleelement="45509"><div class="Module-45509 Textarea">
<h2>Comfortable settings for a relaxing, experience-filled holiday</h2>
<p>Are you looking for camping cabins near Ringk&oslash;bing and Holstebro in Jutland, where nature, peace and quality go hand in hand? At <a href="/en/" target="_self">Thorsminde Camping</a>, we offer camping cabins in various sizes and categories&mdash;perfect for those who want a camping holiday close to the North Sea and just a short drive from towns like Thybor&oslash;n, Holstebro and Ringk&oslash;bing.</p>
<p>With nature experiences, water on both sides and a cosy, relaxing atmosphere, we create a safe setting for both short weekend breaks and longer holidays. Here you get a <a href="https://thorsmindecamping.dk/en/family-camping/">family camping cabin</a> with great camping facilities, designed for different needs, yet all with excellent opportunities for activities for both big and small two- and four-legged guests across the entire site. There&rsquo;s room for togetherness, great facilities and experiences in nature.</p>

									<h2>A wide selection of camping cabins for every taste</h2>
<p>We offer camping cabins to suit different needs, so you can choose the solution that matches your budget, your family and the type of holiday you prefer.</p>
<p>Whether you&rsquo;re looking for a luxury experience, a practical family-friendly cabin or a cheap camping cabin, you&rsquo;ll find it with us. Many choose our cabins as an alternative to a tent or caravan when comfort and flexibility are top priorities.&#8203; </p>
<h3 class="">Our camping cabins include, among others:</h3>
<ul>
<li><p>Meadow cabins with toilet and shower</p></li>
<li>&#8203;Family cabins with toilet and shower</li>
<li>&#8203;Fishing cabin with shared toilet and shower</li>
</ul>
<p>The cabins vary in size and layout, so you can always find options that suit your wishes. We see particularly high demand for cabins in peak season, so we recommend booking well in advance to secure your camping cabin. </p>								</div>

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<h2>Meadow cabins with toilet and shower</h2>
<p>Our 25 m&sup2; camping cabins are designed for those who want extra comfort. You get a spacious kitchen-diner, dining space for six people and a cosy sofa area with TV. The cabins have their own shower and toilet, making them suitable for both families and guests who want a luxurious base close to the North Sea. These meadow cabins with toilet and shower give you high comfort combined with closeness to nature. <a href="/en/cabins/meadow-cabin-with-toilet-and-shower/">Read more about our meadow cabin</a> with toilet and shower on the website.</p>
<h2>Family cabin with toilet and shower</h2>
<p>Family cabins of 25 m&sup2; with space for 4&ndash;6 people come with toilet and shower and are perfect for family camping. There are two bedrooms: one with a three-quarter bed and one with two single bunk beds. In addition, there is a loft with two sleeping spaces. The family cabin has an entrance hall, toilet and shower, an open-plan kitchen-diner and a terrace. <a href="https://thorsmindecamping.dk/en/cabins/family-cabin-with-toilet-and-shower/">Read more about our family cabins</a> on the website.</p>
<h2>Fishing cabin with shared toilet and shower</h2>
<p>If you&rsquo;re looking for a smaller, cheap 10 m&sup2; camping cabin, our fishing cabins are an obvious choice. They are intended for two people and furnished with a caf&eacute; table, box mattresses, a kitchenette and outdoor furniture. They are ideal for couples or solo travellers who want a quiet base with easy access to water, activities and nature. These cabins are also popular with travellers focused on fishing and outdoor life. <a href="/en/cabins/fishing-cabin/">Read more about our fishing cabins</a> on the website.</p>								</div>

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h4 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">About Thorsminde Camping ApS</h4>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-5a1ec25 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="5a1ec25" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>Welcome to Thorsminde Camping &ndash; a cosy, scenic family campsite on the West Jutland coast, where the North Sea meets Nissum Fjord in a unique landscape. The site is run with warmth and personal service by the Maan Katborg family, who look forward to welcoming you to a holiday filled with both relaxation and activities.</p>
<p>Read our <a class="custom47" title="Read more" href="/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/161_ny-trade-and-cancellation-conditions-english.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Terms of Trade and Cancellation Policy</a></p>								</div>
				</div>
